subject.title: [Feature Request] Unified Built-in Sandbox with Multi-Platform Support and Tiered Presets

question: Should this issue remain the canonical sandbox/isolation architecture tracker, or should maintainers split it now into separately owned milestones for secure defaults, plugin/process isolation, IPC proxying, manifest policy, credential scoping, and resource limits?
rationale: The remaining work defines OpenClaw's security boundary and public config/plugin contracts, while current main only has opt-in tool sandbox groundwork.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker and open maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Plugin Isolation
options.body: Scope this issue to native plugin/process and credential isolation only, leaving tool-level sandboxing and preset UX to existing narrower items.

options.title: Defer Broad Architecture
options.body: Leave current opt-in tool sandboxing as the supported posture for now and revisit secure-by-default sandbox architecture only when a product owner sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker and open maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest live discussion signal for keeping this tracker open and deciding how to split the remaining architecture work.
